articles.title: Webb Telescope Spots Signs of Giant Crashes Around Young Stars
articles.summary: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope studied dusty disks around young stars and found signs that Mars-sized worlds may be crashing together.

articles.title: Giraffes Can Do Simple Math, Scientists Find
articles.summary: Scientists in Barcelona found that zoo giraffes can keep track of small numbers of carrots, showing they can do simple math.

articles.title: Did Scientists Just Spot Dark Matter? One Clue Has Physicists Excited
articles.summary: An underground detector called LZ may have spotted a single sign of dark matter, but scientists say they need more data to be sure.
